_readme: Annotated local-dev config. Copy to etc/config.json (or point OVARA_CONFIG at your copy) and replace the token values. This file is itself loadable — keys starting with _ are ignored.
_note_listen_addr: loopback only. The approval API lives on this port — on a shared interface a bound agent could reach it and approve its own escalations. auth_enabled=false on a non-loopback bind is refused at startup unless unsafe_no_auth=true.
_note_tokens: auth_enabled=true requires at least one active credential or the gateway refuses to boot (it would deny every request). operator_tokens: full API incl. approvals + policy. agent_tokens: only POST /v1/runtime/check, /v1/runtime/batch-check, POST /v1/approval/create, GET /v1/approval/{id}, GET /v1/whoami. Generate real tokens: openssl rand -hex 32. Tokens map to stable identities (ag_/op_<hash>); callers may not supply agent_identity themselves.
_note_policy: {version, rules:[{action_type, environment, resource?, allow?|deny?|escalate?}]}. Evaluation order: deny rules → allow rules → escalate rules; no match defaults to escalate. resource uses glob match (e.g. "shell:*"). An action reaching execution needs the matching executor enabled.
_note_receipt_signing: HMAC key behind every receipt's signature field (sig_v1:). With durable trust below, receipts also get an ed25519 gateway_sig (edsig_v1:).
_section_durable_trust: P2.3.x durable signing — set BOTH files or neither. Auto-created on first boot. Signs/seals authority stores and chains them to a tip ledger.
_note_journal_signing_required: true = fail closed if durable trust can't initialize. Remove the key/registry files above and this flag together for unsigned in-memory mode.
_section_lineage: OPTIONAL cross-domain action lineage (lin_v1 bundles + inclusion-ledger registration). ALL THREE keys required together, AND require the durable-trust files above — otherwise startup refuses. Files auto-created on first boot.
_section_persistence: omit any of these for in-memory stores (state dies at restart)
_note_host_executors: true lets approved shell:* / git.* actions run on THIS host via the executor registry (the demo needs it). Leave false to stay decision/approval-only.
_note_trusted_issuers: {issuer_name: base64-ed25519-pubkey}. Required to verify signed capability leases/delegations — empty means lease-gated actions fail validation.
